Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `91831e6d` · 2026-11-16T00:13Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, first content line `Fixes #34148`. 3 files, all on the claimed surface: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` (+30/−2), its pin file `record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx`, and one changeset (patch).
2. **Premise / root cause.** Measured on main, and it holds for the formula half. `text` and `textarea` already wrapped (objectstack#25897). A `formula` (return type `text` or undeclared) still went `FormulaCellRenderer` → `TextCellRenderer`: one line, an ellipsis, the full value only in a `title`. The fix reads a formula through `FormulaField`'s read-only display. It is matched by renderer identity and the `formula` type, the same move the two existing branches make. Grid rows, the highlights strip and a host's own `formula` face keep theirs.
3. **The card's ask 2** (a long-text formula return type in the spec) is no longer needed: a text formula now wraps. Not filed.
4. **Contract.** `Clause-②: no — a value that was cut now shows in full; no surface added`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; no spec path. No contract-review record is owed. Changeset `patch` is right.
5. **Gates on `91831e6d`.** 55 check runs: 42 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failed. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI` and `Check Changeset` are all `success`. Locally the dev ran 38/38 derived gates (exit 0), 399 vitest files green, and an ablation (4/16 red, then restored).
6. **K.** K = 12; < 15, no sync owed.
7. **Governed.** `check-governed-merges --pr 34180`: NOT governed.
8. **Deviations / notes.** Real-browser check NOT MEASURED; accepted, because the change is a renderer choice and jsdom pins it at 1440 and 375 px. The open question (number and date formulas lose the cell's `tabular-nums` on the record page) is accepted as asked: a single value in a detail grid needs no column alignment. The `summary` half is filed as #34182 (p3, `Blocked-by: #34148`): `SummaryField`'s read display has no dark-mode colour, so it was rightly left out here.
9. **Landing.** This stroke: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, under the maintainer's landing approval in the seat thread (2026-11-15T16:10Z, 「批准席位 本班复核通过的 PR 执行 --land」). On MERGED the seat closes out #34148.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [43779205122](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43779205122) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test UI (10/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43779205122/job/133013169437)** — 失败步骤: Run the ui tests (shard 10/16)

  ```

  FAIL   dom  packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx > a deep link to an object read by name always leaves the splash (objectui#13052) > (b) CONTROL: 
    ↳ 失败原因: (这条 FAIL 之后 12 行内没有可识别的原因行 —— 点进 job 看)
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 9 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。

## Test UI (10/16) red again on the synced head `39e8de1d` · 2026-11-16T00:57Z

The same case failed again: `AppContent.disabledPackageDeepLink-13052.test.tsx` › `(b) CONTROL: 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND still draws "Object Not Found"`, at 1039 ms, splash still up (job 133021475780). Two failures in a row, so this is read as real, as the seat's reading said, and it is not re-queued.

It is not this PR's. This diff touches only `plugin-detail/DetailSection.tsx`, its test and a changeset. Both failing builds carry #34176 (`571cf9082a`, merged 2026-11-16T00:20Z), and the head before the sync did not. #34176 moved the shell's plugin-form / plugin-view imports to the `/core` subpaths, so those packages now load on first draw instead of at module load. The likely cause is that this case's 1000 ms `waitFor` now pays that first load. That is the seat's hypothesis; the fix measures it before changing anything.

The fix is owed under #33581, the card #34176 was part of. This PR holds its ACCEPT intent. It is re-synced and re-landed once the fix is on `main`.
